description: Unit test class for the ModifyFeatures class in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing immutability, JSON conversion, object creation, and exception handling.

classes.name: ModifyFeaturesTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the ModifyFeatures functionality, including immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception handling.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ModifyFeatures class is immutable and that certain related classes are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies that the equals and hashCode methods are correctly implemented for ModifyFeatures.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeatures
methods.description: Ensures that creating ModifyFeatures with null features throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the toJson method of ModifyFeatures produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a ModifyFeatures instance from a valid JSON string.

methods.name: modifyTooLargeFeatures
methods.description: Verifies that creating ModifyFeatures with features exceeding size limits throws ThingTooLargeException.
